purpose: Build leakage-safe structured announcement features and fixed 5/20-session label maturity before any V24 supervised fit
fixed_rules: Only binding_approved body facts may become features
Current, previous-guidance and prior-year roles remain distinct
Entry is always the next verified trading session after both publication and first-seen availability
Five-session and twenty-session targets must both mature before training
Freeze-day baseline and archive_reconstructed announcements are never supervised samples
prohibited: No historical return scan or portfolio backtest
No training on V5r2 freeze-day baseline
No unapproved OCR or unbound numbers
No model replacement or trading execution
